g.text: Paired interactions between the atomic interventions

AB/AC/BC are difference-in-differences averaged over the remaining factor; ABC is a third difference. Positive values indicate non-additivity on the rate scale. 2,000 deterministic whole-family percentile bootstrap intervals; descriptive conditional on this authored
